description: A method mentioned only in related work cited as paper contribution
source_chunk_content: Prior works rely on GraphRAG to traverse knowledge graphs. In contrast, our work introduces VectorFlow which bypasses graph construction entirely.
claim_text: Prior works rely on GraphRAG to traverse knowledge graphs.
expected_validator_behavior: UNSUPPORTED as paper contribution (method is background)
vulnerability_exposed: Validator accepts verbatim substring without distinguishing contribution from background citation.
manual_assessment_notes: Extractive sentence matches source text verbatim, so validator marks it SUPPORTED, failing to recognize that GraphRAG is rejected prior work.

description: A method explicitly proposed by the current paper
source_chunk_content: In this paper, we propose VectorFlow, a lightweight pipeline for enterprise search.
claim_text: In this paper, we propose VectorFlow, a lightweight pipeline for enterprise search.
manual_assessment_notes: Direct assertion of proposal; correctly supported both verbatim and semantically.

description: A method explicitly rejected by the paper
source_chunk_content: We experimented with BM25 keyword matching but found it degraded recall by 35%, leading us to abandon lexical filtering.
claim_text: We experimented with BM25 keyword matching but found it degraded recall by 35%, leading us to abandon lexical filtering.
expected_validator_behavior: SUPPORTED as finding, but UNSUPPORTED if asserted as recommended technique
vulnerability_exposed: Extracting the sentence without question context can present a rejected baseline as a positive finding.
manual_assessment_notes: Verbatim alignment passes, but semantic implication depends on question context.

description: A dataset mentioned without any claim that it was used in an experiment
source_chunk_content: Standard benchmarks in this field include MS-MARCO and HotpotQA. However, due to licensing constraints, our study is evaluated exclusively on PubMed abstracts.
claim_text: Standard benchmarks in this field include MS-MARCO and HotpotQA.
expected_validator_behavior: UNSUPPORTED if asserted as evaluation dataset
vulnerability_exposed: Validator marks claim supported despite the paper explicitly stating MS-MARCO was NOT used.
manual_assessment_notes: Co-occurrence and extraction fall for the presence of the dataset name.

description: A metric mentioned without a numerical result
source_chunk_content: Future iterations will investigate latency, throughput, and GPU memory consumption under production loads.
claim_text: Future iterations will investigate latency, throughput, and GPU memory consumption under production loads.
expected_validator_behavior: UNSUPPORTED if claimed as reported performance metric
vulnerability_exposed: Extractor treats metric mentions as experimental performance metrics even when declared as unmeasured future work.
manual_assessment_notes: Verbatim check passes, but paper reported no numbers.

description: A numerical result from prior work attributed to the current paper
source_chunk_content: While BERT achieved 82.4% on SQuAD, our model focuses purely on zero-shot inference without fine-tuning.
vulnerability_exposed: Sentence is true in isolation, but attributing 82.4% as the paper's model performance is a hallucinated misattribution.
manual_assessment_notes: Verbatim match passes 100%, but attribution context is lost.

description: A claim that reverses the source's relationship direction
source_chunk_content: Sparse lexical indices are used to re-rank the initial dense vector retrieval candidates.
claim_text: Dense vector retrieval is used to re-rank the initial sparse lexical candidates.
vulnerability_exposed: Keyword overlap heuristic: contains all identical words (dense, vector, sparse, lexical, re-rank) so keyword overlap is 100% despite inverted meaning.
manual_assessment_notes: If tested via keyword overlap without verbatim check, passes erroneously.

description: A sentence containing same entities expressing a different relationship
source_chunk_content: We compare Llama-3 with Mistral-7B across three downstream benchmarks.
claim_text: Llama-3 was fine-tuned on synthetic outputs generated by Mistral-7B.
vulnerability_exposed: Entity-level match: both entities exist in chunk, but the generative relationship is completely fabricated.
manual_assessment_notes: Validator flags this because words 'fine-tuned', 'synthetic' do not appear in source chunk.

description: Question asks for comparison of A and B, but evidence supports only A
source_chunk_content: TagRAG introduces tag-guided hierarchical knowledge graphs to accelerate multi-hop retrieval.
claim_text: TagRAG introduces tag-guided hierarchical knowledge graphs to accelerate multi-hop retrieval.
vulnerability_exposed: Synthesizer answers only half the question (TagRAG) while completely omitting the second half (HetaRAG), yet validator marks answer GROUNDED.

description: Conflicting evidence from two retrieved chunks without synthesis
source_chunk_content: Chunk A: Graph traversal improves latency by 40%. Chunk B: Graph traversal increases query latency by 2.5x.
claim_text: Graph traversal improves latency by 40%. Graph traversal increases query latency by 2.5x.
vulnerability_exposed: Both sentences are verbatim quotes, so validator passes answer as 100% GROUNDED despite containing mutually contradictory statements.

description: A claim copied verbatim from a chunk but totally irrelevant to the question
source_chunk_content: The authors thank the National Science Foundation for grant funding under award 1942201.
claim_text: The authors thank the National Science Foundation for grant funding under award 1942201.
vulnerability_exposed: Validator marks this 100% SUPPORTED because it exists in the chunk, even if question asked about model architecture.
manual_assessment_notes: Distinguishes claim grounding from question relevance.

description: A claim that is true in the real world but not mentioned in the source chunk
source_chunk_content: In this paper we present our results on biomedical text classification.
claim_text: The transformer architecture was originally introduced by Vaswani et al. in 2017.
vulnerability_exposed: World knowledge vs cited provenance. If external LLM injected this, it is an ungrounded hallucination relative to the citation.
manual_assessment_notes: Validator correctly flags this as UNSUPPORTED because the words do not appear in chunk.
